parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS and normal PR; the only ST/T change is mild concave J-point elevation with upright T waves in V2–V3, which is a normal variant, and there are no STEMI-level ST elevations or reciprocal ST depressions, so this tracing does not support acute STEMI.
